interface.signature:
n m k
a1 a2 ... an

preconditions.description: The number of elements in array a is between 2 and 2 * 10^5.
The constant m is between 1 and n.
The number of subarrays k is between 2 and n divided by m.
Each element in array a is between -10^9 and 10^9.

postconditions.description: The first line of the output contains the maximum possible sum of the beauties of the subarrays in the optimal partition.
The second line of the output contains k-1 integers representing the partition of the array.

invariants.expression: all(pi >= 1 and pi < n for pi in partition_indices)
invariants.description: Each partition index is greater than or equal to 1 and less than n.

invariants.expression: all(pi < pj for i < j for pi, pj in combinations(partition_indices, 2))
invariants.description: The partition indices are strictly increasing.

invariants.expression: all(len(subarray) >= m for subarray in subarrays)
invariants.description: Each subarray has at least m elements.

invariants.expression: sum(beauty(subarray) for subarray in subarrays) == maximum_sum_of_beauties
invariants.description: The sum of the beauties of all subarrays equals the maximum possible sum.
